The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b5a2107e608fdff7), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 5. statement: Let Γ ∈ K , let Λ be any countably infinite ICC group, and let µ and ω be arbitrary normalized scalar cocycles on these groups. (i) Every nonzero bifinite Lµ(Γ)–Lω(Λ) correspondence is a closed bimodule summand of a finite direct sum of the models in Equation (1.3). (ii) Every such correspondence has a finite orthogonal decomposition into full-germ orbit bundles. After choosing distinct germ orbits and allowing zero fibres, all bounded bi- module maps are (1.5) HomM–N ( ⨁ d H(d, σd), ⨁ d H(d, τd) ) = ⨁ d HomCd,α(σd, τd). Norm, adjoint, and composition are fibrewise. Projection summands are exactly projective-representation summands in the fibres. A correspondence K = ⨁ d H(d, σd) has dimensions dimM K = ∑ d dimC(σd)[Λ : Bd], dim KN = ∑ d dimC(σd)[Γ : Ad]. Both are positive integers when K ̸= 0. (iii) Conjugation and Connes fusion correspond to conjugation and balanced tensor product of these bundles. They are equivalently computed by finite double-coset induction. The scalar transports are given explicitly in Equations (3.4) and (3.17) and Section 3.
